questions.stem: Match the following disorders causing secondary amenorrhea with their respective lab findings: Condition Lab Markers 1. Sheehan's syndrome A. Normal LH, Normal FSH, Normal estradiol 2. Premature Ovarian Failure B. High LH, Low FSH, Normal estradiol 3. PCOS C. Low LH, Low FSH, Low estradiol 4. Asherman's syndrome D. High LH, High FSH, Low estradiol
